now: designing a listening tool where people speak back to stories and ai proposes connections to their research questions
activities: recording voice memos about what she heard
sketching meta relations between reflections and rqs
vibe: A playful, poetic builder who names her site Agent Eden and cares most about keeping humans at the center of listening and reflection.
lines: Welcome to Agent Eden. You can name creations, eat an apple, or talk to a snake.
My first agent made soup. It can't tell time, but it knows when the garlic gets fragrant.
Week 2 was a reverse astro chart. If your chart feels wrong, it suggests when to be reborn.
Honestly, the astrology agent limped to the finish line on almost every run. Context got long, consistency fell apart.
Now I'm building Immerse and Reflect: you listen, you speak back, and only then does the AI chime in.
I want people spending most of their time listening, not tagging and highlighting.
This week I'm with Group 3 on the week 8 build.
